== anti-null-preserved-condition
refused: unsupported: LeftAnti join on a key that can be NULL on both sides (build @1, probe @0) with null_equals_null=false: the executor matches NULL to NULL there whatever the flag says, which is set semantics rather than SQL's (#59, #80)

        GpuCoalesceAllBatches: calling_lanes=1, at done: execute_node(#4 CudfCoalescePartitions, lane batches)
          GpuMergePartitions: none
            GpuAggregateBatches: calling_lanes=4, per compaction and at done: execute_node(#2 CudfCoalescePartitions, lane batches), execute_node(#3 CudfAggregate{Merge}, prior output)

== cross-empty-build
refused: invalid plan: no surviving row groups: what an empty scan means is the caller's decision, not an empty map — the wire format reads that as one unmapped partition
